mapper.select: SELECT FROM arch_environment environment WHERE environment.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND environment.type_code=#{typeCode} AND environment.status=#{status} AND (environment.code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ESCAPE '\\' OR environment.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ESCAPE '\\') ORDER BY environment.updated_at DESC,environment.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.update: UPDATE arch_environment SET code=#{code},name=#{name},type_code=#{typeCode},description=#{description},remark=#{remark},updated_by=#{actorId},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT request.id) request_count,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN request.status IN ('APPROVED','FULFILLED','DIFF_FULFILLED') THEN request.id END) approved_count,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN request.status='IN_REVIEW' THEN request.id END) pending_count,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN request.status IN ('APPROVED','FULFILLED','DIFF_FULFILLED') THEN item.cpu_cores*item.planned_node_count+CASE WHEN item.has_sidecar=1 THEN item.sidecar_cpu_cores ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END),0) cpu_sum,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN request.status IN ('APPROVED','FULFILLED','DIFF_FULFILLED') THEN item.memory_gb*item.planned_node_count+CASE WHEN item.has_sidecar=1 THEN item.sidecar_memory_gb ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END),0) memory_sum,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN request.status IN ('APPROVED','FULFILLED','DIFF_FULFILLED') THEN item.database_storage_gb+item.storage_gb+item.extra_cbs_gb+item.local_disk_gb ELSE 0 END),0) storage_sum,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN request.status IN ('APPROVED','FULFILLED','DIFF_FULFILLED') THEN item.planned_node_count ELSE 0 END),0) node_sum FROM arch_resource_request request LEFT JOIN arch_resource_request_item item ON item.tenant_id=request.tenant_id AND item.request_id=request.id WHERE request.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND request.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND request.status NOT IN ('REJECTED','CANCELLED')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cpu_cores),0) actual_cpu_sum,COALESCE(SUM(memory_gb),0) actual_memory_sum,COALESCE(SUM(database_storage_gb+file_storage_gb+extra_cbs_gb+local_disk_gb),0) actual_storage_sum,COUNT(id) actual_node_count FROM arch_environment_instance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND environment_id=#{environmentId} AND status='ACTIVE'
